findings.message: No written North Star exists; the review measured against the PR description instead. Write one with the user.
Unrequested server persistence changes (save debounce, load dedup, meta persistence, try/catch) unrelated to rotation and absent from the PR description; split out or describe.
Unrequested server change: applyClientUpdate now returns boolean; load/save paths reworked; not in PR description.
Behaviour change: a client update that fails to apply is no longer pushed to the update log or broadcast; undisclosed in the PR.
Type-guard cleanup unrelated to rotation; harmless but unlisted in the description.
safeRotation is exported but not listed among the PR's utilities; stated test count unverified against safeRotation/withRotation coverage.
User-visible result unverified (manual test unchecked); getBounds is not rotated so selection boxes/handles show unrotated bounds, and the PR doesn't state this is left short.
Line hitTest wrapped with withRotation is consistent with renderer; other plugins registering hitTest were not checked or covered.

CSS rotation is applied to the deprecated canvas-engine ShapeLayer; the app uses createDomRendererPlugin whose ShapeWrapper (packages/dom-renderer/src/dom-shape-layer.tsx) never reads rotation, so shapes still render unrotated while hit tests rotate — the rendering claim is false in the running app.
Range includes commit 76f78cbc's server behaviour changes (dropped failed updates, load dedup, debounced saves, meta save) not described in the PR; describe or rebase out.
shapeToBounds now uses the rotated AABB, but getVisibleShapeIds has no caller, so the spatial-index change has no effect and the 'viewport scroll' manual test checks nothing this PR changed.
PR says 22 tests; HEAD has 31 (fix commit added safeRotation/withRotation tests).
safeRotation is exported and used by board-store and shape-layer but omitted from the PR summary.
Frame, freedraw, group, island, connector, counter, board-portal, community-region hitTests are not wrapped with withRotation; rotated instances get rotated AABB indexing but unrotated click tests.

Rotation transform added to deprecated ShapeLayer; live DomShapeLayer has no rotation handling, so hit tests/spatial index treat shapes as rotated while they render unrotated. Apply safeRotation/transform in dom-renderer's dom-shape-layer.tsx.

GPU renderer (active) claims rect/rounded-rect/ellipse/line, and its WGSL never reads rotation (params.w unused), so these draw unrotated while hitTest is now rotation-wrapped; previously both agreed. Implement shader rotation or return null from gpuPrimitive when rotation != 0.
rotation: data.rotation passed raw to the GPU buffer without safeRotation, so NaN/non-number can reach the GPU, undercutting 719aa834's validation.
getRotatedAABB and deltaToLocal are public but their angleDeg === 0 guard lets NaN/Infinity through, producing NaN bounds; sanitize with safeRotation inside.
normalizeAngle(-360) returns -0, normalizeAngle(NaN) returns NaN, snapAngle(x, 0) returns NaN; untested edge cases.
Rotated-AABB path in shapeToBounds has no store test; reverting it would fail nothing.
Marquee selection and frame/group drop target still use unrotated getBounds (also lines 657-667); list as follow-up.
Server changes from 76f78cbc look sound but are undisclosed; corrupt client updates are now dropped rather than saved/rebroadcast — state it or split out.

With WebGPU, the GPU renderer takes rect/rounded-rect/ellipse/line and neither rect nor shape-sdf shader reads rotation (shape-sdf uses params.w for kind); these draw unrotated while hitTest un-rotates the click, and gpu-shape-layer hover is an unrotated box test.

withRotation tests pass with the forgery withRotation = fn => fn: the only rotated case is a 100x100 square at 90°, which maps onto itself. Use a non-square shape at 45° with points inside only after/before un-rotating.

ShapeWrapper and fallback rotate every shape type, but only five plugins wrap hitTest; frame, island, group, freedraw, counter, board-portal, connector and community plugins render rotated yet hit-test unrotated.
collision-utils keeps its own unrotated shapeToBounds, and selection-overlay draws unrotated bounds around rotated shapes.
PR test plan says 22 tests; file has 31; safeRotation missing from the Summary's utility list.
Unrelated server changes from 76f78cbc in range (failed updates dropped, concurrent-load guard, debounced saves); correct on reading but undisclosed.
normalizeAngle(-360) returns -0; no test covers it.

Server persistence changes (load-promise dedup, save debounce, boolean applyClientUpdate, thumbnail type checks) don't serve the rotation request; ~150 lines of review surface, the loaded/loadPromise pattern repeated in two files.
normalizeAngle, snapAngle and deltaToLocal have no non-test caller; could be deferred until a caller exists.
getRotatedAABB already early-returns on angle 0, so caller-side zero checks in shapeToBounds and withRotation are redundant.
Same rotate transform plus transformOrigin is duplicated in ShapeWrapper and the fallback; a small shared helper could simplify it.
